tara: Quick heads-up — I ran the kelpie-embed onboard eval on staging with int8 and the recall@10 on the short-query holdout tanked.
mike: How bad are we talking?
tara: Baseline float32 recall@10 = 0.842, int8 (per-channel PTQ) = 0.774. That's ~8% absolute drop. precision@1 also down a bit.
olga: Oof. Which dataset/split? short queries only?
tara: Yeah short queries <= 12 tokens, wiki holdout (5k queries). Full-length set looks fine (drop ~1%). The short tails are the issue.
jason: Any change in normalization/whitening on the pipeline? Could be postproc mismatch.
tara: No changes. Same scaler/whiten steps. Embedding L2 norms look noisier after quant — some centroids shift. I dumped 1000 class centroids and mean cosine decreased by ~0.03.
mike: Can you paste the eval command and the exact quant config?
tara: Sure:
```
./eval_recall.sh --model kelpie-v1 --quant int8 --quant-mode per_channel --holdout short_queries.json --k 10
# quant config: symmetric, clip=0.999, calibration using 5% calibration set
```
olga: Can you try per-tensor symmetric or smaller clip threshold? Per-channel sometimes hurts small-length semantics.
jason: Also try enabling bias-correction in PTQ, and run a tiny calibration with more short queries in the calib set (they might be underrepresented).
tara: Will try per-tensor and increased short-query weight for calibration. Starting a quick run now.
deploy-bot: eval-job kelpie-int8-per-tensor-2026-03-21 started by tara (job id ej-8421)
mike: Also run an embedding distance distribution check: `hist(cosine_sim(float, int8))` and UMAP for a few classes to see cluster overlap.
tara: Pasted the histogram in the job logs — mean drop is small but variance increases. I'll extract UMAPs.
jason: If per-tensor fixes most of it, we can add an onboarding QC: enforce recall@10 delta < 0.03 for short-queries or fail rollout.
olga: Agree. Also add a metric for centroid angular drift median per-class.
tara: Quick update: per-tensor run finished — recall@10 = 0.828 (much better), still -0.014 vs float but within threshold. Will run per-tensor + additional calib examples to see if we can close gap.
mike: Nice. Can you also check cosine similarity on a few hard negatives? sometimes int8 collapses near-zero differences.
tara: On it. If per-tensor is stable, we should mark the int8 artifact as resolved and update the onboarding doc with recommended default quant (per-tensor) and a short-query-focused calibration recipe.
jason: Add an automated check that runs both short and full-length holdouts on each quant config. If short-query fails, block canary.
tara: Adding TODOs to the onboarding PR. Thanks all :thumbsup:
mike: TY! Ping if you need GPUs for more calibs.
